items.quote: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD
items.claim: Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD.
items.object: all the words of the LORD
items.mechanism: Putting the divine words in writing

items.quote: and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill
items.claim: Moses got up early in the morning and built an altar at the foot of the hill.

items.quote: and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel
items.claim: Moses set up twelve pillars, one for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
items.mechanism: Twelve pillars standing for the twelve tribes of Israel
